BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 497,913 ordinary shares as part of its share repurchase program, with transactions occurring between June 8th and June 12th, 2026. The highest price paid per share was 67.40 pence and the lowest was 65.30 pence, with a volume-weighted average price of 66.8069 pence on June 12th. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of outstanding shares to 343,671,246. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 15 June 2026 15 June 2026 Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 08 June 2026 09 June 2026 10 June 2026 11 June 2026 12 June 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 87,674 69,605 184,300 35,358 156,927 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 66.20 66.40 66.00 66.30 67.40 Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 65.80 65.80 65.30 65.80 66.30 Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 66.0056 66.1736 65.7133 66.0596 66.8069 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 347,841,002 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 4,169,756 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 343,671,246 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. This disclosure is made pursuant to paragraph 9.6.6(R) of the Listing Rules. The table below contains detailed information about the purchases made as part of the Share repurchase programme.
